title: Antiproliferative activity and DNA binding studies of cyclometalated complexes of platinum(II) containing 2-vinylpyridine.
authors: Mojaddami, Ayyub; Karimi, Ako; Mahdavinia, Masoud; Fereidoonnezhad, Masood
journal: Biometals : an international journal on the role of metal ions in biology, biochemistry, and medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究环金属铂(II)配合物的抗增殖活性及其与DNA小沟的对接结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作之外的金属-DNA体系且含分子对接，但对象非TF-DNA、无AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: The cytotoxic activity of four cyclometalated platinum(II) complexes [PtMe(vpy)(L)], containing 2-vinylpyridine (vpy) and the phosphine ligands (L) PMe(2)Ph (1a), PPh(3) (1b), PMePh(2) (1c), and P(c-Hex)(3) (1d), were evaluated against human breast cancer (MDA-MB-231), human lung cancer (A549), human colon cancer (SW1116), and non-tumor epithelial breast (MCF-10 A) cell lines. The highest activity was found for 1c with IC(50) values of 21.10 microM, 23.36 microM, and 12.96 microM, compared to cisplatin, which was 10.12 microM, 47.57 microM, and 19.50 microM against the A549, SW1116, and MDA-MB-231 cell lines, respectively. 1a-d showed a higher selectivity index (SI) than cisplatin. Docking studies confirmed interaction to the DNA minor groove for all complexes. Genotoxicity studies on 1c showed interactions with the genomic content of malignant cells. Compared with cisplatin as a positive control, a slight shift was found in the electrophoresis mobility, which was utilized further to study the direct interaction of 1c with DNA.
abstract_zh: 四种环金属化铂(II)配合物[PtMe(vpy)(L)]的细胞毒性活性，其中包含2-乙烯基吡啶（vpy）及膦配体（L）PMe(2)Ph（1a）、PPh(3)（1b）、PMePh(2)（1c）和P(c-Hex)(3)（1d），已针对人乳腺癌（MDA-MB-231）、人肺癌（A549）、人结肠癌（SW1116）及非肿瘤性乳腺上皮（MCF-10A）细胞系进行了评估。发现1c的活性最高，其IC(50)值分别为21.10微摩尔、23.36微摩尔和12.96微摩尔，而顺铂在A549、SW1116和MDA-MB-231细胞系中的IC(50)值分别为10.12微摩尔、47.57微摩尔和19.50微摩尔。1a-d显示出比顺铂更高的选择性指数（SI）。对接研究证实所有配合物均与DNA小沟相互作用。对1c的遗传毒性研究表明其与恶性细胞的基因组内容物存在相互作用。与作为阳性对照的顺铂相比，电泳迁移率出现轻微偏移，这进一步用于研究1c与DNA的直接相互作用。
